Player.title: Player
Player.description: Represents a player in the Hell Let Loose game.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Player entity.

matchesPlayed.description: Number of matches played by the player.

Article.title: Article
Article.description: Represents an article or match report in the Caserna.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Represents a single match in Hell Let Loose. Contains the full data object from the external API.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Match entity.

start.description: The date and time when the match started.

end.description: The date and time when the match ended.

player_stats.description: Statistics for each player in the match.

PlayerAggregates.title: PlayerAggregates
PlayerAggregates.description: Aggregated statistics for a single player across all matches.

processedServers.description: A map where each key is a server name and the value is the ID of the last match processed for that player on that server.

PlayerInteraction.title: PlayerInteraction
PlayerInteraction.description: Represents an interaction (kill or death) with another player.

name.description: The name of the other player involved in the interaction.

count.description: The total number of times this interaction has occurred.

WeaponUsage.title: WeaponUsage
WeaponUsage.description: Represents the usage statistics for a single weapon.

count.description: The total number of kills with this weapon.

GlobalWeaponStats.title: GlobalWeaponStats
GlobalWeaponStats.description: Aggregated statistics for a single weapon across all matches and players.

totalKills.description: The total number of kills with this weapon across all players.

PlayerPeriodStats.title: PlayerPeriodStats
PlayerPeriodStats.description: Aggregated statistics for a single player for a specific period (week or month).

periodId.description: Identifier for the period, e.g., 'week_2024-32' or 'month_2024-08'.

adminUids.description: Array of Firebase Auth UIDs of users who are admins of this clan.

ClanMember.title: ClanMember
ClanMember.description: Represents a member within a clan.

playerId.description: The ID of the player from the playerAggregATES collection.

rank.description: The member's rank or title within the clan.

PromotionLog.title: PromotionLog
PromotionLog.description: Represents a log entry for a member's promotion.

ServerSyncState.title: ServerSyncState
ServerSyncState.description: Stores the synchronization state for a single server, including the ID of the last match successfully processed.

lastProcessedId.description: The numeric ID of the last match that was successfully imported and processed from this server.

lastChecked.description: The timestamp of when the server was last checked for new matches.

/rawMatchResults/{matchId}.description: Collection to store raw match data from the external API. Documents in this collection trigger the aggregation Cloud Function and are deleted after successful processing.

/playerAggregates/{playerId}.description: Global collection of aggregated player statistics. Each document represents a single player and contains their consolidated stats from all processed matches.

/playerAggregates/{playerId}/killedBy/{k.description: Subcollection tracking players who have killed this player and how many times.

/playerAggregates/{playerId}/killedPlaye.description: Subcollection tracking players this player has killed and how many times.

/playerAggregates/{playerId}/weaponUsage.description: Subcollection tracking the kill count for each weapon used by the player.

/playerWeeklyStats/{docId}.description: Aggregated weekly stats for players. Document ID is a composite of player ID and week ID.

/playerMonthlyStats/{docId}.description: Aggregated monthly stats for players. Document ID is a composite of player ID and month ID.

/clans/{clanId}.description: Collection to store information about each clan.

/clans/{clanId}/members/{playerId}.description: Subcollection to store members of a clan and their specific data like rank.

/serverSyncStatus/{serverName}.description: Collection to store the last processed match ID for each server to optimize data import.

/globalWeaponStats/{weaponName}.description: Global collection of aggregated weapon statistics. Each document represents a single weapon and its total kill count.

/articles/{articleId}.description: Collection of articles and match reports displayed in the Caserna.
